newsitem.title: USA: Bouygues Offshore signs turnkey contract.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Offshore signs turnkey contract.

text.p: Bouygues Offshore S.A. said Wednesday that its subsidiaries, Saibos C.M.L. and Nissco, have signed a turnkey contract with Mobil Producing Nigeria Ultd, the operator for the NNPC and Mobil joint venture, for the supply of three new platforms and the laying of six pipelines.

The US$125 million contract, US$70 million for Bouygues Offshore, calls for the engineering, procurement, construction, transport, installation and commissioning of the project on the OSO field in Nigeria, a news release issued by Bouygues Offshore said.
These installations, the release said, will increase the gas supply and collection, through a connection to the USARI field, at the existing gas compression platform on the OSO field.
The delivery of the project is expected by the end of 1998, the release said.
